description: Header file defining interfaces for object name handling, including object ID abbreviation, retrieval, and context management within a repository, for a version control system (likely Git).

methods.name: object_context_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an object context.

methods.name: repo_find_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated SHA1 string unique within the repository, of a specified length.

methods.name: repo_find_unique_abbrev_r
methods.description: Reentrant version that writes the abbreviated SHA1 into a user-supplied buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_repo_add_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Adds a repository-specific abbreviated object ID to a strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_add_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Adds a general object ID abbreviation to a strbuf.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_with_flags
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID with additional flags for interpretation.

methods.name: repo_get_oid
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID given a reference string.

methods.name: get_oidf
methods.description: Formats an object ID from a printf-style format string.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_commit
methods.description: Gets object ID for a commit.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_committish
methods.description: Gets object ID for a commit-ish.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_tree
methods.description: Gets object ID for a tree.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_treeish
methods.description: Gets object ID for a tree-ish.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_blob
methods.description: Gets object ID for a blob.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_mb
methods.description: Gets object ID for a merging base.

methods.name: maybe_die_on_misspelt_object_name
methods.description: Issues an error if the object name appears misspelled.

methods.name: get_oid_with_context
methods.description: Retrieves object ID with context, considering flags.

methods.name: repo_for_each_abbrev
methods.description: Iterates over all abbreviations for a repository.

methods.name: set_disambiguate_hint_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for disambiguating object names.

methods.name: repo_interpret_branch_name
methods.description: Parses a branch name or reference.

methods.name: repo_peel_to_type
methods.description: Peels a ref to a specific object type.
